query:
INSERT INTO plant_molecules (plant_id, molecule_id, percentage, role, notes) 
SELECT p.id, m.id, '0.25', 'majeur', 'Lien Mambe - Source: Wikipedia ES'
FROM plants p, molecules m 
WHERE p.latin_name = 'Erythroxylum coca var. ipadu' AND m.name = 'Cocaïne'
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE notes = 'Lien Mambe - Source: Wikipedia ES';
